summary.en: Add a Magpie model to OpenFilm’s agent menu.
summary.zh-CN: 把本机 Magpie 的模型加入 OpenFilm 智能体菜单。

details.en: Test a model and add it to the desktop agent menu when you choose. The test sends a generated color tile to the local gateway at 127.0.0.1, which routes it through your Magpie model. The workbench uses OpenFilm’s model settings to save your selection.
details.zh-CN: 点「测试并添加」时，会向本机 127.0.0.1 的 Magpie 网关发送一张纯色测试图，由 Magpie 转给你选的模型。测试通过后，工作台通过 OpenFilm 的模型设置保存该模型。

needs.en: OpenFilm desktop 0.4.1 and a running Magpie gateway with an image-capable model.
needs.zh-CN: 需要 OpenFilm 桌面版 0.4.1，以及正在运行且有图像模型的 Magpie 网关。

why.en: When requested, read Magpie’s port setting and query the loopback gateway for its model catalog or send the included test image.
why.zh-CN: 应用户请求读取 Magpie 的端口设置，查询本机网关的模型目录或发送自带测试图。
